chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Nuh ibn Shu'ayb, from the one whom he mentioned, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said:
The one whose water of the back (semen) has changed, let buttermilk and honey be beneficial for him.
ai.seo_question: What is the remedy for changed semen according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* and attributed to Imam al-Rida (AS), this hadith offers a practical prophylactic remedy for changes in seminal fluid, reflecting the Shia tradition of integrating dietary medicine with spiritual health. The prescription of buttermilk and honey highlights the holistic approach to bodily purity (*taharah*) in Shia jurisprudence, where physical well-being is seen as conducive to spiritual devotion.

en.hubeali: H 14670 – A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Nuh Bin Shuayb, from the one whom he mentioned: Abu Al-Hassanasws said: ‘
The one who’s water of the back (semen) has changed, so the butter milk and the honey would be beneficial for him’.
